Design note: at 16px the letters of the calligram resolve into the tree itself — the silhouette carries, exactly like classic tree marks. The 16 and 32 icons use a small-size cut — the ink dilated a hair so thin branches survive the downscale (compare above: native left, cut right). 48 and up are the native rendering. Every icon is a tight crop on bone, so it reads as a deliberate bone square in dark and light tab bars. favicon.ico (16+32+48) plus PNG 16/32/48/180/192/512 and a webmanifest are in the kit; the repo-root favicon.ico has been refreshed with the multi-size build.

Spelling gate (honest receipt): the OG wordmark reads Anastomosis.MD under OCR ✓. The calligram inside the mark reads .md but the tree-letters remain below OCR threshold even at 2048px with preprocessing — the known tw-9 flag. Your eyeball remains the final gate on the mark's spelling, exactly as flagged since the shortlist.

04The link card — 1200 × 630

What people see when a link to anastomosis.md is shared — X, LinkedIn, Discord, WhatsApp, iMessage. Real Instrument Serif wordmark, arteriovenous gradient, brand bone. The tagline matches the loader caption: two vessels, one mind.

05The paste-ready favicon snippet
